target.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle
target.body:
Closes #99054

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Microsoft Teams users who truly remove a personal app/bot and later add it again can continue the same OpenClaw server-side DM session, allowing the bot to use prior conversation context after an app-removal boundary.

This targets Teams app-management removal lifecycle events. It does not claim to detect Teams' local "Remove chat history" action, which live capture showed does not emit an inbound Bot Framework lifecycle activity and can be rehydrated by later messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Teams now routes `installationUpdate` removal activities and bot `membersRemoved` conversation updates into a lifecycle handler. On a removal boundary, the handler removes the cached Teams conversation reference and marks the matching OpenClaw session entry stale by setting `updatedAt` to `0`, matching the existing non-destructive Discord session-boundary pattern instead of deleting transcript data.

The fix handles documented `remove` and `remove-upgrade` installation actions, ignores `add`, and limits channel cleanup to the base channel route plus thread sessions beneath that route.

## User Impact

After a true Teams app removal and re-add, the next inbound message starts from a fresh OpenClaw session instead of silently resuming prior DM or channel context. Operators also avoid retaining a cached proactive-send reference for the removed Teams conversation.

Existing welcome-card behavior, normal messages, reactions, and non-removal lifecycle events are unchanged.

## Evidence

- Added regression coverage for personal `installationUpdate/remove`, `installationUpdate/remove-upgrade`, ignored `installationUpdate/add`, channel bot `membersRemoved`, ignored non-bot `membersRemoved`, and race-safe stale-session patching.
- Added monitor-level coverage proving the Teams activity shim dispatches `installationUpdate` and `membersRemoved` activities to registered lifecycle handlers.
- Validation:
  - `pnpm test extensions/msteams` — 71 files passed, 1002 tests passed.
  - `pnpm run lint:extensions:bundled` — passed.
  - `pnpm lint --threads=8` — passed.
  - `pnpm run lint:extensions:channels` — passed; no extension channel files found.
  - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` — passed.
  - `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` — passed.
  - `pnpm format:check extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/lifecycle-handler.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/lifecycle-handler.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor.lifecycle.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler.test-helpers.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler.adaptive-card.test.ts` — passed.
  - `git diff --check` — passed.
